creator_independence.verified_creation: successful signed tx containing a recognised LaunchLab initialize instruction, signature+slot recorded, mint/pool match
independent_when: not funded by another cohort creator in the lookback window (funding lookback must be declared before collection)
not sharing a fee payer with another cohort creator

cohort_sampling.rule: every verified creation in the declared time window, in on-chain slot order; no filter on price, volume or outcome

cycle_definition.complete_cycle: paper BUY at decision time using only data available_at <= decision, then paper SELL by a rule fixed beforehand, both priced from timestamped exact-size quotes or reserves
exploitable_requires: exit observed or explicit forced-mark rule declared in advance
cycle_definition.unknown_costs: cycle excluded from P&L but kept in denominator and reported

costs_net_pnl.units: lamports and atomic token units, Decimal only
costs_net_pnl.latency_assumption_slots: declared before collection, sensitivity at 1x and 2x
costs_net_pnl.fx: SOL-native; no USD conversion unless point-in-time source with source timestamp

comparison.master_availability: NOT on this branch; on origin/feat/master-live-integration-20261029 (bot/master_decision.py) and origin/integration/consolidation-20261103; genuine frame not fully reconstructible from TradeEvents alone
comparison.primary_metric: mean net P&L per eligible observation in SOL (WAIT counts as 0 with cost 0), paired difference MASTER-REFERENCE
comparison.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over creators (cluster), 95% interval, seed declared
comparison.profitability_demonstrated_only_if: holdout paired difference lower 95% bound > 0 AND MASTER total net P&L > 0 AND targets met AND no unknown-cost exclusion above 20% of cycles

bias_register: regime dependence of a short window
unknown holder data treated as zero
